Ch: the loop stores `baseId` under each of the entry's `variantIds`; getBaseItemId answers from it
xh: the loop stores `variantIds` under `baseId`; nothing reads it

WA: the loop files each entry under its `ids` in monsterByNpcTypeId and under an id and its `version` in monsterByNpcTypeIdAndVersion
_A: returns the `name` of the entry of an NPC type id; Grid.js calls it with `npcTypeId` and application.js with `sourceNpcTypeId`, each for the label of a damage source

jA: the schema of `secondaryEffect` in the schema of the spell list
OA: what the Zod schema's `parse(combatSpells)` returned; every lookup reads this list
$A: names the lookups leave out: the list of a spellbook is filtered by it, and the test Grid.js uses next to `supported` refuses them
VA: stored as `fixedHitDelay` of the spell's definition
KA: a spell in it gets `multiTarget: { radius: 1, maxTargets: 9 }` in its definition
qA: stored as `icon` of the spell's definition; Grid.js and application.js build the path of the icon from it
ZA: filters the list by `spellbook`; Grid.js calls it with `spellbook` for the spell grid

yL: inferred: the list of `{ ids, name, slot, category, version }`; the `_why` of the entries added by hand after it says sync-osrs-data.ts makes the list from the wiki and drops those
wL: the schema of one entry of the list
AL: the array of that schema, which parses the list
LL: parses the record getCanonicalEquipmentId answers from
DL: the synced list and the six entries added by hand, parsed
TL: the second loop collects under each canonical id the ids the record maps to it
IL: the values of equipmentDefinitionById sorted by id
CL: returns that list; application.js filters it by `slot` and reads `id`
BL: Grid.js: `BL(itemId, objTypeLoader.load(itemId).name, "Item " + itemId)`; without a cache name it answers the equipment definition's `name`
WL: Grid.js passes the cache item's `inventoryActions`; when all are empty it answers "Wield" or "Wear" by the definition's slot
PL: returns the ids collected under a canonical id; application.js adds them to a set of item ids

EL: inferred: per staff id, a spell name by spellbook; getActiveSpell falls back to it when no spell is selected
NL: inferred: the definition of that spell for a weapon and a spellbook; what getActiveSpell returns when no spell is selected
GL: getDefaultAttackStyleIndex looks for the style whose `combatStyle` it names for the weapon's category

iB: the entry of 21003 and 27100, which the equipment table names "Elder maul" and "Elder maul (or)"
lB: the entry of 27665, 27679 and 27676, which the equipment table names "Accursed sceptre", "(a)" and "(au)"
oB: the entry of 12006 and 26484, which the equipment table names "Abyssal tentacle" and "Abyssal tentacle (or)"

hD: isAmmoCompatibleWithWeapon accepts only "atlatl_dart" for them; the equipment table names both ids "Eclipse atlatl"
fD: isAmmoCompatibleWithWeapon accepts only "arrow" for them (Dark bow, Twisted bow, Venator bow, Scorching bow)
uD: isAmmoCompatibleWithWeapon accepts only "standard_bolt" for it (Rune crossbow)
vD: isAmmoCompatibleWithWeapon accepts "standard_bolt" and "dragon_bolt" for them (Armadyl crossbow, Zaryte crossbow)
pD: an item of the ammo slot whose name matches is "arrow"
kD: an item of the ammo slot whose name matches is "standard_bolt"
SD: an item of the ammo slot whose name matches is "dragon_bolt"
bD: returns "atlatl_dart", "arrow", "standard_bolt", "dragon_bolt" or "unsupported"; the word "kind" is inferred

JW: getHitDelayWeaponKind returns `JW[getBaseItemId(weaponId)]` before it asks the category
sR: the two values of a style's `combatStyle` that make computePlayerCombatParams answer attack speed 5
dR: the entry of 27665, 27679 and 27676 (the Accursed sceptres) in the timings of a special attack
cR: read only when the second argument is true; playerAttack/launch.js passes `isSpecialAttack` there
